name: Variable Video Production
description: Turn one master brand film into thousands of personalized versions — by name, store, language or offer — at almost no cost per version.

mainEntity.name: What types of businesses benefit most from Variable Video Production?

acceptedAnswer.text: VVP is built for businesses that need many localized or personalized versions of a single video — CPG, beverage, QSR, auto and national retail brands that run co-op programs, and companies in insurance, banking, fintech, telecom and SaaS that send personalized communications at scale.

mainEntity.name: How is VVP different from simply adding a customer's name to a video?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most tools merge a name into a text overlay or subject line. Flipick VVP renders every variable field — name, store address, phone number, product, date or offer — directly into the film itself, so the personalization is part of the rendered video, not a caption on top of it.

mainEntity.name: How does Flipick handle the customer data used to personalize videos?

acceptedAnswer.text: Personalization runs on the fields you already hold in your CRM or PIM — you stay the data controller. Delivery uses your existing, consented channels. Data-handling documentation and a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) are available for security review.

mainEntity.name: Can TCMA or co-op platforms integrate Variable Video Production into their stack?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. TCMA, co-op and VDP platforms and print service providers can white-label VVP as the AI-video layer their stack does not yet have. The process and delivery model mirror existing co-op workflows, with video replacing print as the output format.
